title: pilea pumila var. deamii
intro: Pilea pumila var. deamii, commonly known as Rockweed Pilea or Rock Stack Plant, is a type of flowering plant in the Urticaceae family, native to China, India, and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful in treating various conditions like wounds, infections, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Pilea pumila var. deamii include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
